observation: Warm head coefficients were reused with a newly computed normalization, and a random head refit could lose an effective fine-tuned head.
change: Initialize encoder, first five role rows AND their normalization from R004; initialize person row to zero; adapt last three blocks at .00005; preserve best fine head if its macro F1 exceeds the refit. Team head refitted on the resulting same normalized representation.
selection: Development macro F1 at .65, same dataset v1.1 and no test frames.
note: This is an implementation correction plus training-choice experiment, not an isolated architecture ablation.
